lesson.title: Git Rebase and Conflict Resolution
lesson.goal: rebase a feature branch onto main with git and resolve the conflicts

steps.title: Clone repo and inspect branch history
steps.instructions: Clone the example repository into your workdir, switch to the feature/login branch, and inspect the commit history with git log --oneline --graph --all.

targets.caption: Confirm you are on the feature/login branch and view the diverging commits on main

explanations.topic: How git rebase replays feature commits one by one onto main
Never rebase pushed commits due to commit hash changes
Check remote branches with git branch -a before rebasing
How to abort an in-progress rebase with git rebase --abort
Why rebasing can produce multiple conflict stages

hints: Make sure you clone the example repository and change into its directory first.
Use git checkout to switch onto the feature branch you want to rebase onto main.
Run git clone https://github.com/philomatics/git-rebase-example.git && cd git-rebase-example && git checkout feature/login && git log --oneline --graph --all.
common_mistakes: Staying on main instead of switching to feature/login before starting the rebase.
Rebasing commits that have already been pushed to a shared remote branch.
steps.run_command: git clone https://github.com/philomatics/git-rebase-example.git && cd git-rebase-example && git checkout feature/login && git log --oneline --graph --all

steps.title: Start rebasing feature branch onto main
steps.instructions: Run git rebase main from your feature branch, then run git status to inspect the paused rebase state.

targets.caption: Git pauses the rebase when replaying the first commit causes a conflict in index.js

hints: Which target branch do you pass to git rebase while on your feature branch?
Because git rebase stops with a conflict, run git status afterwards to inspect the remaining commits and unmerged paths.
Run git rebase main and then git status.
common_mistakes: Running git rebase from main instead of checking out feature/login first.
Abandoning the rebase when git prints an error instead of checking git status.

steps.title: Resolve index.js conflict and stage
steps.instructions: Open index.js, remove the conflict markers keeping DEFAULT_USER = "admin", the /profile route and the logging middleware, then run git add index.js && git status.

targets.caption: Remove conflict markers and keep the admin default user
Keep the /profile route and logging middleware

hints: Look in index.js for the <<<<<<<, =======, and >>>>>>> markers inserted by git.
Keep const DEFAULT_USER = "admin"; as well as the /profile route and logging middleware, and delete all marker lines.
Save index.js, then run git add index.js && git status.
common_mistakes: Leaving behind a ======= or >>>>>>> conflict marker line in index.js.
Running git commit instead of only staging the resolved file with git add.

steps.title: Continue rebase and save commit message
steps.instructions: Run git rebase --continue, save and close the commit message editor (:wq in Vim), and let git advance to the next conflict.

targets.caption: After saving the commit message, git pauses on package.json

explanations.topic: Saving and exiting Vim using Escape then :wq
Setting VSCode as git default editor with git config --global core.editor

hints: During a rebase, use git rebase --continue instead of git commit to proceed.
When Vim opens for the commit message, press Esc, type :wq, and press Enter to save and exit.
Run git rebase --continue and exit Vim with :wq.
common_mistakes: Running git commit instead of git rebase --continue.
Getting stuck in Vim or quitting with :q! without saving the commit message.

steps.title: Resolve package.json conflict and finish rebase
steps.instructions: Resolve the conflict markers in package.json, stage it with git add, run git rebase --continue (saving in Vim), and verify with git status.

precision_checks.label: Branch based on main
precision_checks.command: cd git-rebase-example && git merge-base --is-ancestor main feature/login

targets.caption: Remove the conflict markers around the check script in package.json
Rebase finished and the branch is updated

hints: Open package.json and remove the <<<<<<<, =======, and >>>>>>> lines around the check script.
Stage package.json with git add package.json before continuing the rebase.
Run git rebase --continue, exit Vim with Esc then :wq, and run git status to verify the working tree is clean.
common_mistakes: Leaving invalid JSON syntax or duplicate keys when resolving package.json.
Forgetting to run git rebase --continue after staging package.json, leaving the branch in a rebasing state.
steps.run_command: git add package.json && git rebase --continue && git status
